review: The primary reader inspected the whole sheet, both overlapping halves, all ten broad enlarged blocks and twenty-nine focused details at 4–6×. The two slanted left notes were inspected both unrotated and rotated clockwise 18°/25°, with 27°/32° refinements to follow their changing baselines. Every C doubt, C/H difference, cancellation, insertion and mathematical sign was checked visually; all displays and the theorem side rule were included. No context was opened.
